-Improved AI and Combat Interactions

notes.title: UPDATE: Cypress Inheritance: GTX 1080 Ti and HTC VIVE Contest!
notes.notes:
We want to again say thank you to all the people who have our game, we do appreciate the support and feedback!

We started a contest early this year to help to market the game as is and let everyone know about the complete remake of the game. This is still ongoing and we do expect to have out in the last quarter of 2017. 

We are completely rebuilding in UE4 for PC and Mac. We will also  make available for the HTC VIVE and Oculus as well. Additionally we will have the game available in Simplified Chinese.

We have not had a winner to submit as of today and have decided to extend the contest until March the 17th 2017, also updating the prizes. The concerns about someone having a jump because of having the game longer do not seem to be an issue given the fact no one has completed and submitted with all items. 

ANNOUNCING: Cypress Inheritance  GTX 1080 Ti and HTC VIVE Contest. We are running a contest to give away a NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti Graphics Card along with HTC VIVE unit! The contest will run unitl March the 17th 2017.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/02bce55e93ec611e8768713ad6ecc4a0bee46efb.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/c0849acc5aee13398283facd2e245387487d3286.jpg

The first player who is able to collect the items and take the screenshots of the areas that are listed will be the winner of One NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti Graphics Card and also One HTC VIVE Unit! 

All the items below are required to be collected and the screenshot once collected. (SEE MORE DETAILS BELOW ON THE OFFICIAL RULES)
Chp1 (Note: Items will show in wrist device as collected)
All 5 Assets: 
Family history
Financial Records
HDD1
HDD2
HDD3

Chp1 extra
Labyrinth Key
Audio Files
(Note: Find the secret area that houses the virtual world. Then, locate the Labyrinth Key which will allow you access to the small ground vaults on the surface. Within one of the small ground vaults will be the audio files.  )

Chp2 (Note: Items will show in HUD as collected)
43/43 Codes
7/7 Journals

Chp3 (Note: Items will show in wrist device as collected)
4/4 Keys
10 Journals
1 Main key at the end

Once you have the above with your screenshots to verify, you additionally need to have taken screen shots of the areas we are referencing.

Chapter I Screenshot that is required with the above:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/4a92aa8d1b7659d552ed2a871049dd6ab646a5d0.jpg

Chapter II Screenshot that is required with the above:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/6d11005f76a18d3422e815057105d78a5363f56f.jpg

Chapter III Screenshot that is required with the above:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5729577/0c4b587df57f2d5a95bbb669a75afadbb01f05b6.jpg

Finish the game and get the screen shots of your HUD or your Wrist Device, having the items as well as taking the screen shots of the areas we are asking for and then be the first to submit. If you have all the items, shots requested, then send your screenshots of the collected items and the screenshots of the referenced screenshots above, and be the first one to submit these, along with leaving a review on Steam, be qualified, and you will be the winner. Send your submission when complete to Cypressinheritance@cypressinheritance.com  Click here for official rules 

We are running this promotion to build a larger user base and we also would appreciate reviews and feedback of the game with it being complete at this point.  We are still in the process of rebuild and are planning for the relaunch in late 2017!
We again thank you and hope you enjoy Cypress Inheritance: The Beginning.

This with the prior game content additions and menu changes, the game now has  greatly increased frame rate as well as even more for the player to encounter and have an enjoyable playing experience.

notes.notes:
We have released the update and it includes the following:

A I Adjustments
Player Adjustments
Lighting Adjustments

Note: We will have additional update coming soon:

Additional content
Updated UI

Note:  If do have problem with update installing then please uninstall game and then re-install and this should solve the problem. We will continue to update and please let us know of additional issues. Thanks so much for working with us to resolve!

We also wanted to let everyone know that Chapter I is a completed game. We are doing Chapters II and III as bonus content to give additional game play and this is at no additional cost. 

Thanks everyone and we will also have more news coming soon!
